menu.hint: W/S or Mouse: navigate    Enter or Click: select

hint.general: Arrows: adjust    Enter or Click: change    Esc: back
hint.graphics: Graphics changes take effect when you press Apply    Esc: back

desc.volume: Overall loudness. Scales music and sound effects together.
desc.theme: Color scheme for the interface and the night sky. Applies immediately.
desc.resolutionBorderless: Unavailable in Borderless — the game matches your desktop resolution.
desc.msaa: Smooths jagged edges. Higher settings cost more performance.
desc.displayMode: Windowed, borderless fullscreen, or exclusive fullscreen.
desc.vsync: Matches the frame rate to your monitor to stop tearing.
desc.shareStats: Sends an anonymous ping so the menu can show how many people are playing and how many stars everyone has popped. No personal data.
desc.apply: Applies the graphics changes above. You'll be asked to confirm.
